name: query-api
title: Query API (k6)
description: k6 load/stress/spike/soak/ceiling matrix against the Lyo person API across intensity (low/med/high) and cache mode (uncached/cached). /person/QueryConcrete returns full Person entities; /person/QueryProject returns field-projected rows; POST /Query is root From/Joins sparse projection. Uncached iterations page 100-300 persons (varied by VU/iteration); cached mode pins shapes for query-cache hits. Query generation uses a fixed RANDOM_SEED. The 'cases' below describe the request shape behind each scenario; hotspots reference these case ids.
notes: Randomized multi-key sorting is disabled except for the filter_sort case (fixed LastName, FirstName, Id); other cases use server default (PK) order.

cases.description: Unfiltered page of persons in server default (PK) order; no where clauses, no includes. Baseline read cost.
Nested AND/OR QueryNode where-clause tree; stresses the predicate translator with a multi-predicate boolean tree.
Computed field 'streetLine' from a collection-parallel template; dependencies auto-selected server-side.
Scalar-row computed field 'fullName' ({FirstName} {LastName}); no collection-parallel path.
Filters on SourceEntityType then applies a fixed multi-key sort; exercises filter + ordered scan.
Heaviest read path: up to 3 include branches (address/phone/email) over larger pages.
Single nested collection path under Select (e.g. contactaddresses.address.city/postalcode); 2-7 fields.
Root scalar fields only (no collection merge); SQL projection of 2-6 root columns.
Mixed depths under one collection root (unified-root SQL merge + sibling row zip); 2-6 fields.
Two-phase query whose where clause contains a correlated subquery; exercises subquery planning and execution.
100-300 persons with a single 3-table include hop; cache-bypassing via randomized start/amount.
Same chained joins as root_chained_join with TotalCountMode=Exact (From-side count).
POST /Query Person→ContactAddress→Address chained left joins with sparse Select.
POST /Query From Person with no joins; Select FirstName/LastName (From-side paging).
POST /Query Person left join ContactAddress; fan-out collapsed to nested bags per person.
POST /person/QueryProject with randomized mixed root + nested field selection (2-6 fields per request).
